name: Illinois
verified: partial: settings below were checked via search summaries on 2026-10-20; confirm before publishing a place

measures.name: Constitutional Amendment / Referendum
measures.note: Statewide citizen initiatives are very limited; most statewide questions are legislatively referred. Local advisory and binding referenda are common.

constitutionalNote: This amends the Illinois Constitution; changing it again takes another statewide vote.

retention.note: After their first election, judges need at least 60% Yes to be retained. Cook County ballots often list dozens of circuit judges.

primarySystem: Partisan primaries; Chicago municipal elections are nonpartisan with runoffs.

questions.q: Judges on retention ballots run unopposed. When no problem with a judge has been found, what's your default?
questions.note: Illinois retention needs 60% Yes, so a No vote counts for more than in majority states.
